title: Phase 4: S3 Storage Backend
description:
Add S3 (and extensible cloud storage) support for model artifacts. Define ModelStorage protocol with LocalStorage and S3Storage implementations. Support s3:// URIs in model config with local caching.

Part of the Model Primitive MLOps vision (docs/MODEL_PRIMITIVE_PLAN.md).
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Completed Phase 4 S3 storage backend: protocol, local & S3 storage, registry wiring, s3 path caching
